risk_note: B2-19 (funds; D10-2624 / D10-2628 / D10-2677 / D10-2684; patches 1-3). Pinduoduo order_status 5 writes settle_commission_fen with the same value and deduction as the estimate on the same row (null when it cannot be computed, never 0), and the settlement record follows the generic path (re-settlement appends a new seq). The detail field set now reads order_receive_time / order_verify_time / order_settle_time per the official doc (the money r1 S1 root cause: settle time was missing from the detail mapping). One frozen test changes by modify_existing rule_change (BR-FUND-02, D10-2684): [AC-B1-08e-TIME#2] in test/spec/union/orders-shape/pdd-times.test.ts, declared whole by its template text (CT-06zzzzzzzd, #658): detail raw seconds 0 is kept as 0 like the list. specs/order-status-map/pdd.csv and specs/union/pdd.md updated. JD (B2-19a) and the JD refund default (B2-19b) are not in this task.

reviews.note: money r1 (full) fail 1 S1 (detail without order_settle_time re-appended seq with the sync time); fixed by implementation r3 (detail field set per the official doc, D10-2677). r2 incremental pass with 1 S2 (order_settle_time beyond the Date range) registered FU-PDD-UNIX-SECONDS-RANGE.

spec_test_review.note: Rule tests by independent Claude (claude-run.sh, approvals 36), 2 attempts. Spec-test Codex r1 fail -> attempt 2; r2 (last round) fail 1 S1 (test strength). Per the stop-loss line (rulings D10-2590 / D10-2592) the remaining gap is registered FU-B2-19-SPEC-R2-GAPS (before launch), recorded truthfully as fail.
